metadataRaw.title: How to INSTANTLY Relieve Psoas Muscle Pain
metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe demonstrates how to quickly relieve psoas muscle and hip flexor pain.

A tight psoas muscle is a common — and often overlooked — cause of lower back pain. It can also lead to discomfort in the front of the leg, groin, and hip.

Because the psoas is such a deep muscle, traditional massage techniques are usually ineffective at releasing tension or providing lasting relief. Instead, the best approach is to focus on mobility exercises to activate and loosen the muscle, followed by strengthening exercises to prevent future issues.

As a bonus, all of these iliopsoas and hip flexor stretches can be done at home, require no special equipment, and may offer fast relief — sometimes in as little as 30 seconds!

Watch now and learn how to fix a tight psoas at home!
